summary: Golub Capital Private Credit Fund filed an 8-K on July 24, 2026 to disclose previously declared regular monthly distributions for its Class I and Class S shares ($0.1875 gross per share, net of shareholder servicing fees for Class S) and to provide a routine portfolio and NAV update. The filing also reports the fund's NAV, leverage ratio, and industry diversification. No special situation event—such as a merger, tender offer, activist campaign, or strategic review—is described. The distribution and commentary are ordinary-course operational disclosures for a BDC, not a triggering event for special-situation treatment.
